note: The script asks for the hook text, the name super, one key words line and the question text before the button. The other row is captions only. The end card is typed until the LearnFresh logo is in the repo.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: Last second shot. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third. Out at 00:03. Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: Jaelouis C. / 8th grade.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: Last second shot. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third. Out at 00:03. Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: Jaelouis C. / 8th grade.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <8th grade> under it.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words in the top band as he says them: quick math in your head. 2 s.
mg.use: Put it on at the moment he says it and hold 2 s, in the top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: Question text
mg.cue: Top text for 1.6 s before the answer: Why are you happy? Top band.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:00 of this row and hold 2 s, in the top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card lines: <q>Donate to Learn Fresh</q> / <q>learnfresh.org</q>. No logo before this card.
mg.src: No LearnFresh logo file in the repo yet (brand kit is in Airtable). The name is typed until the logo is added to endcards/learn-fresh/.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:24 after the last line and hold it to the end.
